title: Cross-domain workflow guides for key operations pages

PageGuideDialog is wired into Interfaces, DHCP Server, Firewall Zones, Container Management, and IPsec pages.
Containers page exposes guide access in loading, bootstrap, and active management views.
Network Interfaces keeps always-visible Create Interface and Create VLAN/QinQ actions with VLAN below interface action.
Frontend typecheck/lint/build and runtime/browser smoke pass.
assumptions: Guide text remains concise and links to upstream docs for exhaustive references.
This slice is frontend-only and preserves backend/API contracts.
Unrelated dirty files in this worktree remain untouched.
